newsitem.title: USA: Belmont might reopen plants as conditions improve.
newsitem.headline: Belmont might reopen plants as conditions improve.

text.p: Belmont Homes Inc said on Wednesday that it idled two plants during the second quarter as operating income declined but may reopen them as market conditions improve.
Belmont reported second quarter earnings per share of $0.35, including a $0.16 per share gain from a company officer's life insurance policy, compared with $0.37 for the same quarter a year ago.
Operating income declined 46.1 percent to $3.0 million from $5.6 million for the second quarter of 1996, mostly due to higher costs, the company said in a news release.
Belmont idled plants at its Belmont and Spirit, Ark., locations, and closed a leased plant at Spirit. The two idled plants may be reopened, the company said.
